subsystems.name: Ejection modelling
subsystems.role: estimates how often and how fast rocks, dust or comets can escape a planetary system.

subsystems.name: Transit and survival modelling
subsystems.role: tracks carriers through interstellar space and estimates whether biology could survive the journey.
parts: laboratory survival data for analogue organisms

subsystems.name: Capture and delivery modelling
subsystems.role: calculates the chance that a carrier is captured by a target system and lands safely.

subsystems.name: Observational constraints
subsystems.role: tests the model against real astronomical and geological data.

subsystems.name: Parameter inference
subsystems.role: combines all steps into a single transfer likelihood with uncertainties.

subsystems.name: Astrobiological interpretation
subsystems.role: translates transfer likelihoods into implications for the origin and distribution of life.

buildSteps.title: Define the transfer scenario
buildSteps.detail: Choose source and target systems, carrier type — dust, comet, meteoroid or artificial probe — and a time window for the transfer.

buildSteps.title: Simulate ejection
buildSteps.detail: Model impacts or sublimation that launch material, and compute the velocity distribution relative to the escape speed of the source body.

buildSteps.title: Simulate interstellar transport
buildSteps.detail: Integrate trajectories through the galaxy's gravitational field, including close stellar encounters and the ambient radiation field.

buildSteps.title: Estimate biological survival
buildSteps.detail: Apply laboratory data on radiation, vacuum, desiccation and temperature tolerance to the computed transit time and shielding.

buildSteps.title: Model capture and landing
buildSteps.detail: Simulate gravitational capture by the target system, then atmospheric passage and survival on arrival.

buildSteps.title: Combine into transfer probability
buildSteps.detail: Multiply ejection, survival and capture probabilities to get a likelihood for each source–target pair.

buildSteps.title: Validate against observations
buildSteps.detail: Compare predictions with detected interstellar objects, meteorite records and exoplanet statistics, then adjust parameters.

buildSteps.title: Publish maps and predictions
buildSteps.detail: Output maps of plausible transfer routes and testable predictions for future surveys and sample-return missions.

pathway.unlocks: first quantitative maps of where interstellar transfer is plausible.

pathway.unlocks: empirical ejection rates and size distributions to constrain the models.
